GOLD · TREND MOMENTUM↗

GoldCheetah

GoldCheetah waits for XAUUSD to break out after consolidation. Entry requires both price structure and momentum to qualify. Each trade opens with a stop and has its own exit.

Reported daily trade countAbout 1–2 trades / day
Partner strategyExplore →
GOLD · BASIS STRATEGY↗

GoldOwl

GoldOwl tracks the difference between gold futures and spot prices, known as the basis. When it detects a divergence, it takes opposing positions. The result depends on convergence and the cost of both legs.

Reported daily trade count2–20 trades / day
